info.title: NEAR x402 demo paid work API (testnet)
info.description: Deterministic paid work demo behind the NEAR x402 facilitator at test.x402.mikedotexe.com. Payment is 1,000 atomic units of Circle test-USDC on NEAR testnet per request, settled through NEP-366 signed delegates with relayer-sponsored gas.
info.x-guidance: POST /work with JSON {"input": "<string>"}. An unpaid request returns 402 with x402 v2 payment requirements base64-encoded in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header (scheme exact, network near:testnet, 1000 atomic units of test-USDC). Sign the NEP-366 delegate payment payload and retry with it base64-encoded in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE request header. The 200 response is the deterministic SHA-256 digest of the canonical request body.

post.summary: Deterministic SHA-256 work, paid via x402 (NEAR testnet USDC)
post.description: Unpaid requests receive a 402 with x402 v2 payment requirements in the base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. Resubmit with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header containing the signed payment payload. The payment-identifier extension is optional: include it to opt into delivery-replay idempotency (replaying the identical paid request returns the cached result without a second settlement; reusing an identifier with different work is rejected).

input.description: Arbitrary input string; the result is the deterministic SHA-256 digest of the canonical request body

200.description: Deterministic work result (replayed is true when served from the delivery journal)

402.description: x402 payment required; requirements are in the base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header

409.description: Payment identifier already used for different work
